name: contextdb
description: Connect Qoder to cloud context from Alibaba Cloud ContextDB, with enterprise knowledge bases and long-term memory. Native Qoder Hooks automatically recall knowledge-base content and relevant memories before each turn and capture context afterward. Supports knowledge-base knowledge graphs, multi-level memory organization, and distilling memories into documents for knowledge bases. Bundled Skills provide search and management for knowledge-base documents, memories, and private ContextDB Skills.
descriptionZh: 为 Qoder 接入阿里云 ContextDB 的云端上下文，连接企业级知识库与长期记忆：通过 Qoder 原生 Hooks，在每轮对话前自动召回知识库内容与相关记忆，对话结束后自动沉淀。支持知识库知识图谱、多级记忆整理，以及将记忆提炼成文、沉淀至知识库；配套 Skills 提供知识库文档、记忆与私有 ContextDB Skills 的检索和管理能力。
